indie.hero_sub1: Most independent films don't stall because the story is weak. They stall because the project doesn't look ready.
indie.hero_sub2: Notes are scattered. Plans are vague. Materials feel unfinished. When someone asks a practical question, the answer isn't clear.
indie.hero_sub3: It's not a talent issue. It's a structure issue.
indie.hero_sub: Pzaz Indie gives independent filmmakers the same powerful tools used by professional studios — without the enterprise price tag.
indie.confidence_p2: Producers, partners and investors are not just evaluating your script. They are evaluating whether you can execute it.
indie.confidence_q1: Can you explain your scope clearly?
indie.confidence_q2: Can you show how the film unfolds visually?
indie.confidence_q3: Can you demonstrate that you've thought beyond the draft?
indie.confidence_q4: Can you answer production questions without hesitation?
indie.confidence_closing: Structure creates confidence. Confidence attracts belief.
indie.home_p1: Indie gives your project a home.
indie.home_p2: A single environment where your script, ideas, planning, collaborators and production thinking live together and evolve together. When everything sits in one place, your film starts to feel real.
indie.home_p3: And when it feels real to you, it feels real to others.
indie.home_tagline: Everything in one place. Everything connected.
indie.shift_p1: Most independent filmmakers compensate with effort. More messages. More revisions. More late nights trying to organise everything before a call.
indie.shift_point1: Your development lives next to your planning.
indie.shift_point2: Your ideas connect to your breakdown.
indie.shift_point3: Your collaborators see the same evolving context.
indie.shift_closing1: You're not scrambling to assemble your film before every meeting.
indie.shift_closing2: Instead, you're building it steadily, visibly, confidently.
indie.free_p1: Built for independent reality, Indie is not a teaser tier. It is the structural foundation every independent film deserves.
indie.free_closing: With Indie, you don't need permission to operate like a professional.
indie.whatyouget_description: Everything you need to prepare your film properly:
indie.whatyouget_f8: Task coordination with notes and attachments
indie.whatyouget_plan: The plan includes <bold>1 core user</bold>, up to <bold>3 external collaborators</bold>, and <bold>1 active project</bold> at a time. You also receive <bold>100 AI credits per month</bold> to support structured development inside your film's working environment.
indie.whatyouget_closing: Enough to build something serious. Simple enough to stay clear.
indie.ai_description: AI in Indie isn't there to hijack your screenplay or impersonate your voice. Its job is quieter and far more useful. You remain the author and you keep your independence, but your process becomes sharper.
indie.ai_card1_desc: See the structure of what you've already written — elements, patterns, and opportunities you might have missed.
indie.ai_card2_desc: AI supports early breakdown thinking by surfacing elements inside your script without imposing a direction.
indie.ai_card3_desc: Think a step ahead without losing your tone. Explore alternatives while keeping your creative voice intact.
indie.ai_card4_desc: Works inside your project — aware of your context, your draft, and most importantly, your direction.
indie.funding_p1: When your film is organised, structurally thought through, and visibly coherent, the dynamic in the room begins to change in ways that are difficult to fake but easy to feel.
indie.funding_p2: You're no longer pitching a fragile idea that needs protection; you're presenting a project that has weight, logic, and a form of forward momentum. Practical questions stop feeling like traps and start feeling like signals of interest, because you can answer them calmly, clearly and without searching through scattered notes or half-finished documents.
indie.funding_p3: Investors aren't put off by ambition, and they're not even put off by uncertainty. What unsettles them is ambiguity — the sense that the execution lives somewhere in the future rather than in the present.
indie.funding_closing: Clarity reduces perceived risk, and perceived risk is often the real barrier to belief.
indie.cta_description: You don't need a studio budget to operate with real structure. Indie gives you the kind of structural confidence usually associated with larger productions — without cost, without friction, and without forcing compromise.
indie.cta_closing: Build your film on something solid.
